name: Boston
living: the PIXEL triangle sign's neon hums with a rare soft flicker (glow mask)
light-tower lamp banks glow and breathe gently, moths and dust motes drifting through their cones
the golden-hour pixel clouds drift slowly across the sunset (sky layer drift)
brownstone and Back Bay tower windows flicker on one by one as the sunset deepens
the LONG LIVE LOFI board's little heart pulses softly
the manual scoreboard on the green wall flips a number tile after each home run
a small flock of birds crosses the orange sky now and then
a red aircraft-warning light blinks slowly on top of the tallest tower
crowd shimmer, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
